verdict.rationale: Querying and exporting recorded robot data is a fair question for a robotics simulator that generates sensor data, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only shows building blocks: sensor data generation (gazebo-gh-14), gz-transport pub/sub and service calls (gazebo-docs-36), and CLI introspection tools (gazebo-gh-10). None of it documents a data recording, query, export, or SQL capability for offline analysis, and no API spec was found.
